about: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 (Malta, HLTV event 8932). Day 1 = 14 Oct 2026, day 2 = 15 Oct 2026, day 3 = 16 Oct 2026. Every result below was read off HLTV's own event-results page or the individual HLTV match page; pre-lock picks and probabilities come from this repository's frozen pick history (hotspawn/data/pick_history.json, entries with frozen=true) and from the Pinnacle guest-API reads it records. Map details for day 2 come from the HLTV match page for 9z-Falcons and from Hotspawn's own day-2 review for the other two matches. Day-3 prices were read from bo3.gg's match page (which names the bookmaker it relays) and from Polymarket's market. Compiled by session arena/a6f05f99 on 2026-10-15 22:40-23:10 UTC.

event.name: Thunderpick World Championship 2026
event.format: Two BO3 GSL groups of four; the two group winners go to the playoffs, the group decider winner joins them. Single-elimination BO3 semi-finals, then a BO5 grand final.

matches.note: Not offered as a Hotspawn pick'em fixture in any capture this repository holds, so there is no Hotspawn pick to make for it. Listed here so the day-3 picture is complete; it is not counted in the board's coverage numbers.

lessons: Day 1 gave the board's best result and day 2 gave its worst, and the split is not random: the two leaderboard plays that worked were the two where the crowd was on the side our own numbers said was the weaker one by a wide margin (Aurora at 73% price with 95% crowd on 9z-Aurora day 1; PARIVISION at 53.4% with 69% crowd on PARIVISION-BetBoom day 2).

Day 2 also shows the cost. Legacy-FURIA was priced near a coin flip (57.6% FURIA) with 73% of the crowd on FURIA; fading that crowd lost 7 points against most of the field even though the number was reasonable. A 4-point edge on a near coin flip is not enough to justify being different.

9z's day-2 line is the most useful new information for day 3: they lost 1-2 to the tournament's strongest side but took a map off them and lost the other two only 9-13. The team the market priced at 24% on day 2 was not the team that lost 2-0 without a map.

Aurora's reply was equally clear: 2-0 over Ninjas in Pyjamas with a 1.65 rating from Wicadia. The day-1 loss to 9z looks like a bad day, not a broken team - which is why the day-3 price still makes Aurora the favourite.

The July rebuild is real but old news: kyxsan and Jimpphat joined on 8 and 3 July 2026, roughly 100 days before this match, and Aurora reached a StarSeries Fall final and sit 5th on Valve's standings with them. Rostermania is a tiebreak on a close match, not a reason to back a long shot.
